jumps.name: Quarterly earnings surprise
jumps.reason: FQ1 FY2027 earnings (Oct 28, 2026) is the near-term event that confirms or refutes the growth needed to justify the price: the reverse DCF implies 11.6% year-1 revenue growth, which the note judges well above ADP's recent organic trajectory; ADP's largest single-week historical moves are earnings-release weeks.
jumps.cite: Fact sheet Price section 'Next earnings date | Oct 28, 2026'; fact sheet Fair value section (reverse DCF 11.6% growth implied); note section 3 ('Valuation') and evaluation Bear case

annual_probability.cite: mc-inputs.json analogues.event_weeks: of ADP's 20 quarterly earnings-release weeks from 2021-10 to 2026-07 (~4.75 years), only 1 produced a move of 10%+ in magnitude (2023-10-23, Q1 2024 earnings, -0.1111) -- about 1 per 4.75 years, i.e. ~0.2/year.

impact.cite: Largest-fall analogue, week 2023-10-23, Q1 2024 earnings release, move -0.1111 (mc-inputs.json analogues.largest_falls and analogues.event_weeks, both confirm this week as the earnings-release reaction).
